product.name: Monoprice Cat6 CMP Bulk Ethernet Cable - UL TAA Solid (w/spine) UTP 23AWG 550MHz Pure Bare Copper Pull Box 500ft Black
product.description: This 500‑foot roll of high‑performance bulk Cat6 Ethernet cable from Monoprice™ is made with solid, 23AWG, 100% pure bare copper conductors and is UL® listed. It has a CMP plenum fire safety rating, allowing to be safely used in the plenum air spaces of commercial buildings. It is fully compliant with UL Code 444 and National Electrical Code® TIA‑568.2‑D fire and safety standards, which require pure bare copper wire in communications cables.Tested to perform to speeds up to 550MHz, it guarantees high‑speed data transfers for server applications, cloud computing, video surveillance, and online high‑definition video streaming. This TAA and RoHS compliant cable features Reelex® packaging to ensure it dispenses easily, without twists, tangles, snags, or overruns.
